content.content:
Apply by reading the dependent and the prerequisites; there is nothing to run.
1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it contradicts.
2. License: no element of the dependent adds a rule the prerequisites do not state. Fail on any such element — name it — including an element that restates a rule a prerequisite records as belonging to another recorded decision or as outside its own scope.
3. Applicability: the criterion is applied to the requirement sentence the dependent is meant to carry. Fail when the dependent carries no such sentence — empty or placeholder content — an absent elaboration is not a silent pass.
content.rationale: The dependent is a requirement sentence and the prerequisites are one prose node and two requirement sentences, so this edge is read, not run: the prose edge is the natural-to-structured cell, and the two requirement-sentence edges are the structured-to-structured default cell, which reuses the gate form and is flagged for a matrix extension. Every cell is the same non-violation check, and both of its limbs are stated in the criterion: an elaboration may narrow what the prerequisites commit, but it may neither contradict a prerequisite nor add a rule they do not state, including restating a rule a prerequisite records as another recorded decision's to state or as outside its own scope. The use gated here is the dependent's reliance on vxltqruo for the object and act of abandonment, on slwvtspu for the discard being the end of an open draft, and on pvnszwum for the workspace's start being the node's change, so that the working copy is the change above that start and a missing workspace leaves no start to read. The criterion is applied to the requirement sentence the dependent is meant to carry, so a dependent that carries none — empty or placeholder content — fails rather than passing vacuously; an absent elaboration proves nothing. Findings name the offending element at check time; nothing is named in advance, so rewording the dependent or a prerequisite leaves the criterion intact.
